editor.publishConfirmationText: I hereby confirm that this is original content created by me, or that I hold the necessary rights to publish it. I have fact-checked the sources and claims presented, and all images, quotations, and bibliographic references are correctly and fully credited to their original creators or copyright holders. I understand and accept that, as the author, I am responsible for the accuracy, originality, and legality of this content, and that UNTOLD may unpublish it if these commitments are not met.
